from rest_framework.generics import ListAPIView
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from rest_framework.exceptions import PermissionDenied
from .models import ImpersonationAuditLog
from .serializers import ImpersonationAuditLogSerializer

class ImpersonationAuditLogListView(ListAPIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]
    serializer_class = ImpersonationAuditLogSerializer

    def get_queryset(self):
        user = self.request.user
        if not user.is_staff:
            raise PermissionDenied("Only security compliance officers may inspect impersonation logs")

        queryset = ImpersonationAuditLog.objects.filter(target_user__tenant_id=user.tenant_id)
        target_user = self.request.query_params.get('target_user_id')
        if target_user:
            queryset = queryset.filter(target_user_id=target_user)
        return queryset
